text:
Yean spoke most (about 17 messages), with replies from Chun Monunhh and HENG BUNKHEANG; the thread covered AO3 task assignments, the deadline, and the GitHub repo.

- AO3 is due **Oct 13 at noon**. Yean asked everyone assigned a section to finish by Monday night so they could finalize it Tuesday morning; no meeting this week.
- Section 1 interaction diagrams are already done in Part One. Chun Monunhh was assigned the Section 2 class diagram; Bunkheang and Heejae Choi the Section 3 system architecture, with subsections for them to divide. Documentation team handles project management.
- Yean asked Chun and Bunkheang to push code to the existing GitHub repo. Chun said it is not empty, just private; Bunkheang said making it public was okay. Whether the professor can access it was raised.
- Report One received **40/40** and Report Two Part One **30/30**. Yean congratulated the group and thanked Dneang for leading Part One.
- Chun asked which part they were assigned; Yean replied “here,” but the referenced context is unclear.
